QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_3

question.text: When were the Indian Social Stock Exchange segments (NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE) officially launched?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Indian SSE segments (NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE) were launched as dedicated segments of the NSE and BSE for fundraising by Social Enterprises, following SEBI's SSE framework amendments to the ICDR Regulations in mid-2022 and the July 15, 2022 notification of ZCZP as a 'security' under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956. The commonly referenced launch month/year for these segments is September 2022. The Trap: July 2021 predates the regulatory framework. April 2020 reflects an unrelated COVID-era period. January 2023 corresponds to early ZCZP issuances rather than the segment launch. Note: The cited Social Impact Assessors workbook pages reviewed support the July 15, 2022 ZCZP notification and reference the September 2022 SSE framework circular in a footnote, but the exact September 2022 launch date for NSE-SSE/BSE-SSE was not located in the cited workbook pages themselves. The launch date framing above reflects publicly available SEBI/exchange information rather than a direct workbook citation.
